answer: Draw a 7-juror quorum per submission. Compare their hashes. If 3 or more diverge, slash the submitter and pay the majority jurors from the slashed stake. Vest every juror payout over 20 epochs, so a bought jury waits 20 epochs for a whisper of profit. The unit of trust is the task, not the address, so a raven with 1,000 accounts still needs 7 stakes and 20 epochs of vesting per quorum; the zenith of that investment is a loss.
